conflicts: Level range: Warcraft Tavern 52-60; timesaver.gg says gear requires level 43-55 (118 listed items).
Warcraft Tavern says BRD has 27 possible bosses; timesaver.gg lists loot for 24 boss/rare sections.
wowtbc.gg lists Crusader's Armor (Grebmar), Circle of Flame (Flamelash, epic), Doom'rel and Anger'rel loot; timesaver.gg does not.

31 items appear on wowtbc.gg only (not timesaver.gg). Their IDs were matched by exact name to Wowhead Forever tooltips within the dungeon level range; stats come from the tooltip. Where the tooltip shows no drop source, the wowtbc.gg boss/trash heading is kept and drop_chance_pct is null. See each item's notes.
gaps: Boss levels and NPC IDs not found.
Quest rewards without a drop source are stored in quest_rewards with quest null.
Kill/drop counts unavailable; drop_rate_display derived from tooltip drop_chance_pct.
Trash coverage is incomplete: only timesaver.gg trash/dungeon-wide items and wowtbc.gg names that could be matched to Forever tooltip IDs are included.
Mid-dungeon event bosses (Seven Dwarves members other than Doom'rel/Anger'rel, Ring of Law champions beyond listed loot) not separately researched.
Dungeon-wide section includes many quest rewards (ring/quest items) whose quest was not identified.
